Location: Dubai, Country: UAE

Description:
DarGlobal FAQ (official website; reviewed 20 November 2026)

COMPANY AND MARKETS
DarGlobal develops luxury properties, branded residences, communities and destinations with global partners. It describes its approach as design, integrity and purpose. It says it operates across 14 cities in 9 countries, listing Spain, London/UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece and the Maldives. It is headquartered in London and publicly listed.

INVESTING
The FAQ describes ROI as return on investment (financial growth and capital appreciation), ROE as return on ego (pride, identity and social value), and ROL as return on legacy. It says international investors are welcome and refers to full ownership rights, residency privileges where applicable, local regulatory frameworks and escrow systems. It describes off-plan benefits as early access, attractive prices, flexible payment plans and potential appreciation; it does not promise a specific return. It says developments are positioned for capital appreciation and rental yields but gives no guaranteed yield.

BUYING
Process: choose a property; review the investment plan with an advisor; reserve the unit; sign digitally or through an office; complete payment and registration with support. Registration is with the relevant land department or authority in each country. Typical documents are passport copy, contact information, reservation form and payment details; additional requirements may apply by market. Payment plans vary by development. Buyers can consult advisors and complete purchases digitally or through global offices.

PROJECTS AND PARTNERSHIPS
Portfolio includes branded villas, penthouses, resort-style residences and city apartments. Locations named include Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol, Maldives and London. Co-branded residences are collaborations across fashion, hospitality and design, with elevated architecture/services and brand equity. Furnishing and customization depend on project. The FAQ directs buyers to advisors for current availability and upcoming launches.

text:
[DarGlobal | about | Global] DarGlobal Homepage and Current Company Facts

Location: Global

Status: Indicative data aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026

Key Facts:
  - Track record: 32 years (homepage indicative figure as of Q3 2026)
  - Gross development value: USD 23 billion (homepage indicative figure as of Q3 2026)
  - International markets: 7 (homepage indicative figure as of Q3 2026)
  - Global brand partners: 12+ (homepage indicative figure as of Q3 2026)

Description:
DarGlobal official homepage snapshot reviewed 20 November 2026. DarGlobal describes itself as a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager. It creates communities, landmark destinations and lifestyle-led assets across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and London, with hospitality, commercial, entertainment and golf community assets. It says it owns, invests, develops and operates real estate, combining global partnerships, market fundamentals and disciplined execution.

Homepage headline figures are explicitly indicative and aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026: 32 years track record; USD 23 billion gross development value; 7 international markets; 12+ global brand partners.

Business areas include integrated luxury communities; hospitality and leisure operated with global brands; private membership clubs; golf-led communities; commercial real estate intended to generate recurring income; Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), a DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary headquartered in DIFC that structures equity, debt and hybrid real estate opportunities across GCC, European and US gateway markets; and tokenization / digital ownership initiatives.

Homepage newsroom items visible on review date: 19 Nov 2026, successful launch of the USD 700 million Trump International Simaisma, Qatar destination; 16 Nov 2026, new Jeddah mixed-use development valued at SAR 1 billion; 26 Oct 2026, DGCP cross-border investment mandate; 7 Oct 2026, sales opened for Trump Villas Simaisma; 30 Sep 2026, HY 2026 results and portfolio GDV of USD 23 billion; 6 Aug 2026, construction contract for Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai.
